entities.summary: Chen Chin-feng is a former professional baseball outfielder. A Taiwanese aborigine of Siraya tribal ancestry, in 2002, he became the first player born in Taiwan to play in Major League Baseball. He is currently the manager for the Fubon Guardians of the Chinese Professional Baseball League.
